segments.title: Chương 17: 《Sắp thi đại học, hệ thống ly hôn nghịch tập đến》Ủa, không phải chứ chị, chị lại đầu tôm thế?
segments.content:
Chapter 17: Damn, no, sis, are you that delusional? The fantasy of a student weak in some subjects: bad at English, but a god at math. Admired by all, favored by teachers, with the class beauty fawning over him.

In reality, bad at English, sucks at math.

Even though the English teacher had called him out last semester, this semester she still couldn't connect him with a score of 140, feeling a surreal sense that this person didn't exist.

Returning to his seat, the students around him all turned to look.

Jiang Nian felt a bit embarrassed, coughed, and laid out his test paper, pretending nothing had happened.

Although the English teacher had repeatedly forbidden chatting, she couldn't stop the enthusiasm of the surrounding students. One by one, they stared at Jiang Nian with looks of disbelief.

"Holy shit, you really memorized all thirty-five hundred words?"

"Yep. Quiz me on a random one."

"Jiang Nian, can I borrow your paper to look at?" a girl at the front desk asked bashfully. "I want to see how you wrote your essay."

"Yeah, sure."

In the next group of desks, Zhou Yuting clutched a corner of her English paper, feeling as if she'd been plunged into an icy cavern. Jiang Nian scored 573? More than forty points higher than her? Was there still any hope of moving up to the advanced class?

In principle, it was survival of the fittest; anyone who passed the threshold had a chance. But in practice, only one student from each parallel class could usually move up.

The reason was simple: all the good students had already been sent out. The class's overall level would drop from the top of the parallel classes to the bottom. What homeroom teacher would want to lead a marketplace of a class?

So, every homeroom teacher was rather conservative about the class promotion policy. If a student was truly outstanding, their parents would demand it anyway, so it was better to just let them go without a fuss.

If a student merely had a chance to move up, the homeroom teacher would usually adopt a gentler approach in their conversation.

Are you sure you want to go? Young man, what lies ahead is... hell!

Why would a Mazda driver try to squeeze into a party of Mercedes and Rolls-Royces? You won't be able to keep up, and you might get sent back.

Usually, at this point, the student would chicken out.

After moving up, there were two more major exams. If their scores fluctuated too much, they'd be advised to return. It didn't matter if you cheated your way up or were just having a bad streak, you'd be advised to return all the same.

Carrying your desk to join the Olympiad class was glorious, but carrying it back to your original class was utterly humiliating.

At this thought, Zhou Yuting couldn't help but clench her fists. Her five pale fingers curled unconsciously, knuckles turning white, trembling slightly.

One English exam had destroyed her Olympiad dream.

A new class, a new persona, new simps... The thought of those nerdy, bespectacled top students not falling at her feet made Zhou Yuting want to grind her teeth to dust.

Jiang Nian! It was all his fault!

"What'd you want to see me for?"

At noon, in a shady corner of the basketball court, under the lush canopy of trees.

Jiang Nian held a red bean popsicle, tore open the wrapper, and took a lick before looking up curiously at Song Xiyun, who had dragged him out here.

"So secretive. Can you tell me now?"

He hadn't had much contact with Song Xiyun before, because of Xu Qianqian. Plus, with all the running around he'd done for the placement test recently, they had become somewhat familiar.

"What were you doing last night?" Song Xiyun's expression was unnatural.

Jiang Nian gave her a suspicious look, wondering why she had the expression of a wife who'd caught her wealthy husband cheating—wanting to confront him but afraid of divorce.

A new roleplay scenario? The Temptation of Going Home?

Sis, I'm pretty sure we're innocent here.

Song Xiyun wore a loose, white summer school uniform with light-colored pants. She was a cute-style beauty, her looks an 80 out of 100 or higher, dressed rather plainly.

Nope, not happening.

"Nothing much. I was in the classroom for evening self-study," he said, slurping his popsicle.

"Liar!" Song Xiyun's face flushed. "You weren't in the classroom at all, you clearly went out!"

I really wasn't on Shenyang Avenue, the era of tough guys is over...

Jiang Nian slurped his popsicle and started giving a random answer, "How did you know I scored 573?"

Who asked you that!

Because a father knows his daughter best. "Wait, you scored 573?" Song Xiyun looked shocked, then after a moment's pause, asked again, "How much? How much did you score?"

Jiang Nian grinned, slurping his popsicle.

"Since you asked so sincerely, then I'll..."

Song Xiyun did a quick mental calculation. "Doesn't that mean you're moving up to the advanced class? The cutoff score couldn't possibly be higher than 550. Your score would be mid-tier even in the Science Olympiad class."

"Yep." Jiang Nian slurped.

Song Xiyun was speechless. "Can you please put down your popsicle? You're making me sick."

"Want a taste?" He offered it to her.

"No, thanks." Song Xiyun composed herself, remembered her purpose, took a deep breath, and asked, "Last night, did you get a gym membership?"

"Whoa, were you following me?" Jiang Nian was suddenly startled. "Secret admirer much?"

"Get over yourself!" Song Xiyun couldn't quite handle Jiang Nian's bizarre train of thought and started to feel sorry for Xu Qianqian. She had no idea how her best friend put up with him.

She certainly couldn't. She was so annoyed she wanted to throw up.

"Then how did you know I went to the gym and got a membership?" Jiang Nian seemed to have returned to normal, squinting at the hot sports field under the blue sky and white clouds.

Gusts of hot wind blew, and his mood was pleasant.

"Aren't you curious how I knew you got a membership?" she retorted.

"Why?" Jiang Nian seemed a bit distracted.

"Because my mom was the one who signed you up."

"Oh, huh?" Jiang Nian looked up. "That was your mom? I was wondering why that lady looked so familiar. But your mom has a much better temper than you."

Song Xiyun became bashful again. "I just wanted to ask, why did you suddenly get a membership, and spend so much money on classes?"

"To work out, obviously. How was I supposed to know that was your mom?"

"How do you explain buying the classes? You don't have time to attend them, do you?" Song Xiyun pursed her lips. "And with your physique, plus being on the basketball team, what kind of working out do you need?"

"There's no rule saying basketball players can't..." Jiang Nian stopped mid-sentence, glanced up at Song Xiyun, and looked at her cautious and suspicious eyes.

In that moment, he seemed to realize something.

"No way, sis, you don't think I'm interested in your mom, do you? What the hell, are you that delusional?"

"What?" Her thoughts exposed, Song Xiyun's defenses instantly crumbled, and her face flushed crimson. "No, that's not what I meant. I just happened to find out."

"My mom was worried you wouldn't have time for the classes and that the money would be wasted. And, well, I think so too. It's not like your money grows on trees, so if you want a refund..."

"No need. Mind your own business," Jiang Nian said, waving his hand dismissively. "I was going to get a membership and buy classes anyway. If not from your mom, I would've bought them from someone else."

"Really?" Song Xiyun asked.

"Yep. If there's nothing else, you are dismissed."

"Hmph." The weight on Song Xiyun's chest was finally lifted. "Heehee, I'll be going then. I have to tell Qianqian you scored 573."

Watching Song Xiyun's retreating figure, Jiang Nian was lost in thought.

This girl has a dirty mind.

Ding! [On your first day at the gym, your 38-year-old self has already seen results from the classes you bought. Determined to make a comeback, you decide to purchase an additional sixty classes.

Mission: Repurchase sixty class sessions. Reward: 30,000 RMB]
